|---|

| 📍 **q-0037.0013.0006** · How is the path ahead found and shown: the space of open questions and tickets mapped from the roots, the next slices ranked by a stated criterion, and the picture the person sees? |
|---|

I agree with you on one point, disagree on two, and the disagreement is where the shape gets sharp.

**Agreed: not the pacer's child.** The two decide on different rungs. The pacer answers what the next step is inside chosen work and where to resume, decisions at code and a feature. Pathfinding answers which work, a product slice. The method already sorts decisions by how far they reach, and things that decide on different rungs are different mechanisms (💡 [*Autonomy*](AGENTS.md:205)). The pacer consumes the path; it does not own it. The ordering rule's binding to the pacer's question was the misfiling, and the question I opened yesterday-evening under it inherited it. It should move, either under q-0037 in its own right or under [q-0037.0018](docs/questions/q-0037.0018-what-is-a-projects-product-document-to-the-method-and-which-of-the-methods-mechanisms-keeps-it-and-the-projects-work-in-agreement-both-ways.md), the product document's derivation into work. I lean to its own place, because it reads three roots, not one record.

**Disagreed: it should not investigate purpose.** Purpose is already investigated and kept by four things: an align on a question under *what is this project for*, where the decisions are made; `/discover`'s outside view; `/advise`'s freeform read, which is the freeform pathfinding you describe, already there, without a record or a method; and the product mechanism, which keeps the document, checks it against the work, and opens a decided answer's building. A pathfinder that investigates too becomes a second owner of purpose (💡 [*every fact to one home*](.claude/skills/maintain/SKILL.md:3)). What nothing does is **derive**. The product skill's queue view renders coverage *for the person ordering the work* and then stops, on purpose: *it ranks nothing*. That missing step is the pathfinder, whole.

**Disagreed: purpose does not dictate the path, even ideally.** It dictates value. It says nothing about means, and the compounding criterion arose because in a self-building project the tool for the next slice matters more than the next pain. And purpose is a hypothesis until the landscape root measures it: q-0038.0001, whether working under the harness delivers better, is open with no ticket. So the path weighs three things, and they are the three roots: value from *what it is for*, leverage from *how it is built*, evidence from *the landscape*. The weights are yours, in the local file. That is also why the tree reading of the last turn saw at once what no ticket view could: two roots hold no ticket at all.

So the shape I would put forward: a pathfinder mechanism that reads the store from its roots, the product document's coverage and the live tickets; ranks candidates by value, leverage and evidence under the person's weights; shows the path with each candidate's reason, drawn; and is asked two ways, by `/recall` and the pacer for the next, and by you freeform for where to go. `/advise`'s *what next?* becomes its output. What need not exist: a purpose-populating step, since making the imbalance visible is what it adds, and a rule in the queue, since the compounding criterion becomes one of its weights (💡 [*Occam*](AGENTS.md:30)).

✏️ **Landed change — [docs/questions/q-0037.0013.0006](docs/questions/q-0037.0013.0006-how-is-the-path-ahead-found-and-shown-the-space-of-open-questions-and-tickets-mapped-from-the-roots-the-next-slices-ranked-by-a-stated-criterion-and-the-picture.md) · The shape, as argued 2026-10-20**

> Not the pacer's child: the pacer decides at code and a feature, pathfinding at a product slice; the pacer consumes the path. Not the investigator of purpose: purpose is investigated at an align, by `/discover` and `/advise`, and kept by the product mechanism; what nothing does is derive, and `product.py --queue` stops one step short on purpose. Purpose dictates value, not the path: the path weighs value from q-0033, leverage from q-0037, evidence from q-0038, the weights the person's. Two modes, one method: in the loop for `/recall` and the pacer, freeform for the person. Not: a step that populates the purpose root; not: a rule in the queue.

This is at 🛠️ self-improvement=the method, above the dial, so it is argued and not settled; the uncommitted body is the question's whiteboard (💡 [*Above it, it settles nothing*](AGENTS.md:221)). The next step, if you take the shape, is its align, and I would open it with a discovery: how projects elsewhere derive what to do next from what they are for, so the weighing is not only ours.

|---|

| Where the question lives: its own child of q-0037, or under q-0037.0018 |
| Commit the question's body as it stands, with 01-0020.0010's close already pushed |
